::: {#def-boundedness .theorem}
## Boundedness

A component function is bounded if it takes values in a finite set, i.e. there is a finite $D$ such that $g_{ti}(\mathbf{X})\in D$ for all $\mathbf{X}\in\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{X}_t)$. An exposure mapping is bounded if it is separable and all its component functions are bounded.
:::
